title: Beyond the Chessboard
next_chapter_hook: For the first time, the Eye of Heavenly Dao revealed an expression beyond calculation. In those eternally indifferent eyes, a long-absent battle intent flickered—it admitted that Chen Ji had exceeded its predictions.

text.content:
Chen Ji stared at the three choices suspended in the void, each draped in resplendent golden light, emanating suffocating majesty. Since time immemorial, countless prophets made choices within this same framework—sacrifice, compromise, or mutual destruction.

Yet now, he finally saw through the hidden patterns beneath that golden radiance. This was no gift, but a sealing formation fueled by his Heavenly Fate Value. Every choice was merely adding fuel to this prison.

"Interesting."

An aged and indifferent voice echoed from all directions. Chen Ji recognized this as the dominating voice that had resonated through the void moments before. It called itself the Chess Player of the Eternal Chess Game, an existence beyond fate.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze piercing through layers of mist toward the source of that voice—where there was nothing, only void. Yet he knew with certainty that within that emptiness lurked a pair of eyes scrutinizing him like an ant.

dialogue.content:
"To see through this disguise does give me some surprise." The voice carried a hint of playfulness. "But it matters not. You must still make a choice—step onto that old path walked countless times by prophets."

The golden light intensified, the outlines of the three choices growing ever clearer.

text.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed.

The laughter was soft, yet it sounded particularly jarring in the vast void. His shoulders trembled slightly, as if hearing the funniest joke in the world.

"What are you laughing at?" The voice carried a rare note of displeasure for the first time.

Chen Ji ceased laughing, cold light suddenly blazing in his eyes: "I laugh because the Eternal Chess Game is, after all, nothing special."

He raised his hand, pointing to those three golden choices.

"You want me to choose—sacrifice my Heavenly Fate for fleeting peace, bow in compromise to become your chess piece, or destroy myself in mutual annihilation?"

Chen Ji's fingertip traced an arc through the air, precisely severing the connection between the three golden lights and himself.

"These three paths, you've let countless prophets walk." He paused, his voice turning sharply cold. "But what makes you think I must choose within your framework?"

A silence echoed through the void.

Chen Ji could feel that scrutinizing gaze becoming sharper, as if reassessing him as a "chess piece." He did not retreat; instead, he stepped forward.

"You've plotted for eons, using generations of prophets as chess pieces. The Tianji Record is merely one of your pieces in this world, and you—" A mocking smile curved Chen Ji's lips, "—don't even know how many pieces you have, do you?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji questioned the Eye of Heavenly Dao: 'By what right do you decide the framework of my choices?'—He needs to find an entry point to tear apart the false mask of this Eternal Chess Game.

choices.description: Directly exposing the true purpose behind the Eye of Heavenly Dao's Eternal Plot—it needs to constantly consume prophets' Heavenly Fate Value to sustain its own existence.
choices.visible_reward: The Eye of Heavenly Dao trembles for the first time
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the wrath of this ancient existence

text.content: Chen Ji's voice turned sharp: "You think I don't know? You let generations of prophets peer into Heavenly Secrets, consuming their Heavenly Fate Value, and those consumed values—" He abruptly raised his hand, an arcane formation pattern appearing in his palm, "—are feeding this monster lurking in the void!"

choices.description: Pretend compliance while secretly gathering strength, waiting for the opportune moment to deliver a fatal strike.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, gain opportunity for counterattack
choices.risk_hint: May be seen through by the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: Chen Ji concealed his mocking smile, replacing it with an expression of fear. He lowered his head, voice trembling: "The junior... understands." Yet beneath those lowered eyelids, his gaze was cold as a blade. He was waiting—for that instant when the ancient existence would reveal a flaw.

choices.description: Awaken the Destined Twin Chen Tianming, to gain support at a critical moment
choices.visible_reward: The Destined Twin appears to support, breaking the deadlock
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming may be harmed in the process

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was about to speak, a cold voice rang out: "It has no right to decide for you." The voice was identical to Chen Ji's, yet carried an entirely different chill. Chen Tianming's form materialized from the void, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji. "Brother, I'm here."

A cold hum echoed through the void. The three golden lights suddenly blazed, transforming into three chains that swept toward Chen Ji. Where the chains passed, the void trembled and rules shattered.

"Insolent!" For the first time, the aged voice carried fury. "You think seeing through the surface gives you qualification to challenge the immutable laws?"

Yet Chen Ji stood unmoved where he was.

dialogue.content:
"I did not come to challenge." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "I came to tell you—from today onward, the rules are set by me."

The moment these words fell, the incomplete Tianji Record in his embrace suddenly burst with dazzling light. The complete Tianji Record unfolded at this moment, every page burning with golden flames.

text.content:
That light was entirely different from the golden light projected by the Eye of Heavenly Dao. This was another kind of law—one not belonging to this world, not bound by this void.

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power surge from the Tianji Record, resonating with his Heavenly Fate Value. He saw the space around him distorting, tearing, reorganizing—a new space was being born with him at its center.

"This is..." For the first time, the aged voice wavered.

Chen Ji stepped forward, each step expanding the boundary of the new space by one zhang. He moved slowly, yet with absolute resolve.

"This is a space independent of your control." He spoke, his voice echoing through the newborn space. "Here, your rules—are void."

Golden light clashed with golden light, two entirely different laws trading blows in the void. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's chains halted three feet around Chen Ji, unable to advance even an inch further.

Standing at the center of the space he had constructed, Chen Ji finally achieved eye-level contact with those eyes hidden in the void. He discovered it was no longer empty void—those eyes actually displayed surprise.

dialogue.content:
"I make no choice." Chen Ji's voice clearly spread throughout the space. "I wish to transcend choice itself."

He raised his hand, pointing toward the Eye of Heavenly Dao: "Your Eternal Chess Game, from this day forward—is abolished."

choice.prompt: Chen Ji announces 'I make no choice, I wish to transcend choice itself'—Now he needs to take concrete action to prove the weight of these words.

choices.description: Using the complete Tianji Record as the foundation, establish one's own rule system within the new space.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate Value

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, the pages of the Tianji Record flipping frantically. New laws surged forth like a tide, covering the original sealing formation. He felt his Heavenly Fate Value burning rapidly, but what of it? He would teach this Eternal Chess Game—who was the true Chess Player.

choices.description: Reverse the sealing formation,让它反过来束缚天道之眼
choices.visible_reward: 获得对天道之眼的制约手段

text.content: Chen Ji sneered, fingers flicking gently. The formation originally targeting him began to reverse, golden chains turning toward the depths of the void. "How about using the cage you designed for me to imprison yourself?"

choices.description: 彻底切断天机录与天道之眼的联系，让预言者获得真正的自由
choices.visible_cost: 天机录可能永远无法完整
choices.visible_reward: 历代预言者的牺牲终得安息

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, pouring all his divine consciousness into the Tianji Record. He felt countless residual souls—grief and怨念 of generations of prophets—rushing toward him. He did not resist; instead, he spread his arms wide: "Elders of past generations, today I shall take you home."

After completing all this, Chen Ji felt a剧烈眩晕. His Heavenly Fate Value had been consumed to a dangerous threshold, yet his gaze remained clear.

The newly constructed space had fully formed. Within this domain independent of the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control, Chen Ji finally achieved true autonomy.

He turned, gazing at that主宰 still coiling in the void. Those eyes no longer held the previous indifferent scrutiny, but displayed an expression Chen Ji had never witnessed before—interest. Genuine interest.

"Interesting."

The aged voice sounded again, but this time without the previous condescending charity, carrying instead a hint of playful appreciation.

"Since the beginning of time, you are the first person to dare act outside my framework." The voice paused. "And the first... to genuinely surprise me."

Chen Ji did not speak, merely watching that void quietly.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji." The voice pronounced his name for the first time, each word carrying some ancient rhythm. "I admit, I underestimated you."

A pair of eyes emerged from the void—true eyes, not projections from emptiness, but golden eyes carrying boundless majesty. They gazed at the space Chen Ji had constructed, a complex light flickering within them.

"Perhaps from the very beginning, I should not have treated you as an ordinary chess piece."

text.content:
Chen Ji met those eyes, a faint smile curling his lips: "Finally, you said something human."

This sentence was like a loud slap across the万古主宰's face. Yet this time, the Eye of Heavenly Dao did not rage; instead, it emitted a low laugh.

That laughter echoed through the void, carrying an emotion Chen Ji had never experienced before—the anticipation of meeting a worthy opponent.

"Very well." Those golden eyes narrowed slightly. "Since you wish to play chess, I shall accompany you in this game."

The words fell, and the void began to dissipate. Those eyes, that void, that sealing formation fueled by Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value—everything faded from Chen Ji's sight.

But before dissipating completely, that aged voice said one final thing: "Chen Ji, I remember you. In the next game—I shall move the pieces myself."

When everything returned to tranquility, Chen Ji discovered he stood once more on the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. The night wind brushed past, stirring his robes. The Tianji Record lay quietly in his embrace, as if nothing had happened.

But he knew, everything was different now.

He had successfully broken the Eye of Heavenly Dao's framework, establishing his own rules. That万古巨兽coiling in the void had, for the first time, acknowledged his existence.

Chen Ji raised his head toward the starry sky, his smile growing increasingly profound.

"Moving the pieces personally?" he softly repeated the Eye of Heavenly Dao's final words, his eyes utterly without fear.

He drew out the Tianji Record from his embrace, turning to the final page. There, he saw a new name slowly emerging—not his name, but another he had long sought.

Chen Nian.

"Heavenly Fate Lock Key..." Chen Ji murmured, complex emotions flickering in his eyes. "It seems the chess game of fate is even vaster than I imagined."

He put away the Tianji Record and descended the mountain under the moonlight. The new chess game had begun, and he—was already prepared.
